create_digit360_instance: create a Digit360 instance by connecting to a serial port with optional timeout
read_digit360_message: read a Digit360Message from the connected device by calling the read method
decode_cobs_data: decode COBS-encoded bytes into a Digit360Message frame using the decode method
send_data_to_device: send raw bytes to the Digit360 device over the serial connection
measure_timedelta: measure time deltas and compute average Hz using the TimeDelta class
